_comment: Cross-language LSML hash-parity golden for the N-blueprint envelope (ADR 001 criterion 7, extends issue #18). The layout binds two text nodes to TWO distinct blueprint keys via the '<key>.<leaf>' path form (score.value / timer.value) — the wire shape the multi-blueprint envelope produces. ts_canonical/ts_hash were regenerated by the REAL @lumencast/compiler canonicalize()+hashBundle() (Lumencast/lumencast-js packages/compiler/src/canonicalize.ts) against the bundle Orion's EmitLSML emits for multiBlueprintLSMLRoot, and proven by calibration: the same generator reproduces the committed issue-#18 single-blueprint golden hash (sha256:494fa4eb…) byte-for-byte. Orion's lsml.HashBundle of the equivalent layout MUST byte-match ts_hash and ts_canonical — this is real Go↔TS parity, not a Go-minted value. [Regenerated for LSML 1.2 (ADR 002 §3.5 #G): only the `lsml` version token changes; both SDK canonicalizers are byte-identical, so the 1.2 canonical+sha256 are deterministic.]
